name: FrySharp
author: Code Fry Dev
description: Interactive in-app C# development and automation studio featuring a dedicated project/script manager, syntax-highlighted editor, real-time Roslyn compilation diagnostics, in-memory execution, visual gutter breakpoints, interactive stepping (F5/F10/F11), locals/watch inspection, and immediate evaluation.

DefaultTemplate.label: Default Starter Script
DefaultTemplate.description: Initial template loaded when creating a new script

ShowLineNumbers.label: Show Line Numbers
ShowLineNumbers.description: Display gutter line numbers along the left margin

AutoCheckErrors.label: Live Roslyn Diagnostics
AutoCheckErrors.description: Continuously analyze C# code in the background for syntax and semantic errors

ExecutionTimeoutSeconds.label: Execution Timeout (seconds, 0 = no limit)
ExecutionTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum allowed run time before script execution is automatically stopped. 0 disables the automatic limit — Stop is always available regardless.

EnableSyntaxHighlighting.label: Syntax Highlighting
EnableSyntaxHighlighting.description: Apply language-aware colour themes to keywords, strings, and identifiers. Disable for a plain-text experience.

EnableAutoCompletion.label: Auto Completion
EnableAutoCompletion.description: Show IntelliSense completion suggestions while typing. Disable to get more screen space and fewer interruptions.

releaseNotes: Release 2.0.4: Introduces animated GIF export, recording, and rendering with a high-performance LZW encoder and color quantizer. Adds full ECharts 3D surface and chart integration with factory support and runtime testing. Adds direct creation of notebooks and servers from the studio explorer context menu. Adds customizable text editor context menu and edit actions. Refines notebook gutter layout for compact view, and improves cross-platform test stability with TimeGate and TimeFact execution gating.
